scientific.integrity: The source-supplied fixed-locus data are separated from the quotient reconstruction. Smoothness of the cubic quotient and branch curve is checked symbolically; the three A2 types follow from the exact tangent weights, and the degree-one del Pezzo conclusion follows from the finite quotient formula in codimension one.
scientific.limitations: Specific to the explicit complex complete-intersection K3 surface in Burek's Example 14. The originality assessment cannot exclude an older projectively equivalent presentation of the same quotient surface.

title: The order-six quotient in Burek’s Example 14 is a degree-one \(3A_2\) del Pezzo tower
